scope: 17 fixed samples; search plus candidate metrics and result construction; excludes original-repair validation, input parsing and output I/O

required_environment.vendor_mode_evidence: explicit user confirmation plus read-only OEM MainOption.json OperatingMode = 2 before and after each block; no control-center UI interaction
required_environment.windows_power_scheme: record actual scheme and require it to remain unchanged throughout the run

threshold_revision: 2026-10-27: user explicitly changed average CPU limit to <= 6% and peak to <= 10%, all other conditions unchanged; applies to idle admission and measured background CPU. Prior protocols and attempts remain unchanged.
load_monitor: Windows Processor(_Total)/% Processor Time performance counter. Independent admission uses native typeperf at 1 Hz. Runner uses CounterSample pairs from the same counter; no GetSystemTimes P/Invoke, no source compilation, and no process-wide CPU enumeration in measured blocks. Power checks occur before the intervening quiet window.
monitor_overhead_evidence: Native typeperf six-counter probe: 0.25 CPU seconds plus waiting supervisor 0.1875 CPU seconds over 34.0257185 seconds on 32 logical processors, 0.040181% machine CPU combined. Process-wide attribution is a separate intrusive diagnostic and cannot qualify an idle window.
summary_unit: mean of 10 sample-search totals within a block; median and range over 8 blocks per stage
rejected_data: Save all warmup and measured attempts. On an environment violation, stop the attempt and retain it as incomplete/rejected; never replace individual unfavorable timings or mix attempts into one complete dataset.
correctness: Every process output must be byte-equal to its stage's release correctness output; all four stage candidates and preserved programs must exactly match the original baseline.
limitations: Single physical machine and research test entry point; no affinity binding or allocator peak instrumentation; hardware mode is user-attested and cross-checked against OEM configuration, not independently read from firmware; no product performance certification or whole-converter timing conclusion.
